modes.cue_notes: Ground through the back heel, square the hips forward, and lift through the chest as the arms reach overhead. Hold for a steady breath count, keeping the front knee tracking over the ankle.

breathing_cues.entering: Inhale as you step the back foot into place and rise up through the spine, arms sweeping overhead.
breathing_cues.holding: Steady even breaths; each inhale lengthens the spine, each exhale sinks the back heel and grounds the legs.
breathing_cues.exiting: Exhale to release the arms and step the feet back together, or flow into the next shape.

prop_free_variation: Shorten the stance and keep the back heel lifted (high lunge) if the hips or sacrum resist squaring forward.
